name: Repowise
description: Indexes a codebase's graph, git history, docs, and decisions locally and serves ten MCP tools plus a dashboard, so coding agents can answer questions and assess change risk.

skills.name: Repository Overview
skills.description: Summarizes architecture, module map, entry points, and git health.

skills.name: Cited Answers
skills.description: Answers a question with hybrid retrieval, graph expansion, and citations.

skills.name: Change Risk
skills.description: Reports what a commit, range, or uncommitted change made worse and which tests touch it.

skills.name: Architectural Decisions
skills.description: Returns architectural decisions with verbatim evidence, falling back to git history.

skills.name: Dead Code
skills.description: Lists unreachable code by confidence tier.
